description: This file contains extension methods for configuring and augmenting ISiloBuilder instances in Orleans.Hosting, including clustering configurations, activity propagation, and registration of distributed grain directory.

classes.name: CoreHostingExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for ISiloBuilder to configure hosting and clustering options in Orleans.

methods.name: AddActivityPropagation
methods.description: Adds activity propagation filters to the silo builder to enable tracing across grain calls.

methods.name: UseLocalhostClustering
methods.description: Configures the silo to run in development mode with local clustering and localhost endpoints.

methods.name: UseDevelopmentClustering
methods.description: Sets up development-only clustering with a specified primary silo endpoint.

methods.name: UseDevelopmentClustering
methods.description: Configures development clustering with options configured via a delegate.

methods.name: UseDevelopmentClustering
methods.description: Configures development clustering with options configured via an options builder.

methods.name: AddDistributedGrainDirectory
methods.description: Enables the distributed grain directory in Orleans hosting, registering necessary services.
